summary.title: Team workflows are underserved
summary.text: Shared workspaces, query libraries, and role-aware collaboration remain recurring gaps in negative reviews.

summary.title: Export workflows create friction
summary.text: Users repeatedly ask for clearer export paths for diagrams, data, and implementation-ready artifacts.

summary.title: AI can be a differentiator
summary.text: A modern product can turn query explanation, generation, and remediation into a visible advantage.

findings.title: No shared workspace for teams
findings.description: Users report that connections, saved queries, and review workflows remain local or hard to share safely.

quotes.text: Team-based workflows are difficult to coordinate across users.

implementationSteps: Add workspace entities for shared connections and saved queries.
Introduce permissions for owner, editor, and viewer roles.
Create a migration path from local-only saved assets.

findings.title: Query history is not searchable enough
findings.description: Users want persistent history with quick search, filters, and recall across sessions.
implementationSteps: Add search and date filters to the history panel.
Cap stored entries and expose clear-history controls.

findings.title: ER diagrams need PDF and image export
findings.description: Diagram views are useful only if teams can export them for documentation and architecture reviews.

quotes.text: Diagram export is needed for documentation workflows.

implementationSteps: Add export actions to the diagram toolbar.
Support SVG and PNG capture from the rendered graph.
Use the browser print workflow for PDF output.

findings.title: No app-level lock
findings.description: Users worry that anyone with access to the device can inspect saved connections and query history.
implementationSteps: Store a hashed PIN in the native settings layer.
Show a full-screen lock after inactivity.

findings.title: AI-assisted SQL is already covered
findings.description: Text-to-SQL and explanation features are a positive differentiator when implemented clearly.
